About Me

Namaskar, I am Sarang, a PhD research candidate at the Center for Scientific Computing and Computational Mechanics (CSCCM), Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi), working with Prof. Dr. Souvik Chakraborty. My research work is on "Agentic Artificial Intelligence for Computational Science".

My research aims to develop Agentic AI Systems, bringing multimodal reasoning into computational science workflows, drawing inspiration from how human scientist observes, hypothesize, and validate. This will hopefully extend the human scientific capabilities to explore wide range of new, valid, and feasible hypotheses.

Fundamentally, I will be focusing on three coupled domains : Discovery, answering "what equations governs this physical system ?", Analysis, finding "what does the mathematical model predicts ?", and Design, building "what configurations acheives the goal ?".

I come from Nashik, Maharashtra, India. I have completed B.E. in Mechanical Engineering from PESMCOE and M.Tech in Modeling and Simulation from SCMS, SPPU, Pune, India.
